title: Servicing Standard for Draws on a Summit Line
content:
This standard governs draws on the line of a Cedarline Summit Proprietary Reverse Mortgage.

## The standard

1. Only plans that carry a line can be drawn; a Summit Fixed Lump Sum or Summit Second Lien has no line.
2. A Summit draw is booked only while the loan status is active.
3. Draws stop for good once a maturity case is opened on the loan.
4. A draw must be at least the plan's minimum draw amount and no more than the available line.
5. A draw requested by phone may not exceed the plan's phone draw limit.
6. The disbursement method must be one of the plan's draw methods, and a wire is used only for a draw of at least the plan's wire minimum; a smaller wire request goes by ACH.
7. Each draw request, identified by its draw request confirmation number, is disbursed once, within the plan's draw processing period in business days.
8. A disbursed draw books one line draw, which reduces the available line, and one advance posting of the type "line draw", which adds to the Summit balance — both for the same amount and the same date.
9. Advance postings of other types follow only from a reserve disbursement, a property charge advance or an occupancy inspection, each for the same amount and date as its origin.

The loan's status and its available line are read from the company's loan record for that loan, not from the borrower's account of them.

## Decision table

| Question about the request | Where the answer is found | Result if not met |
|---|---|---|
| Does the plan carry a line? | the plan of the loan | no draw |
| Is the loan active? | the loan's status | no draw is booked |
| Has a maturity case been opened on the loan? | the loan's maturity case record | draws have stopped for good |
| At least the plan's minimum draw? | the requested amount | no draw |
| No more than the available line? | the loan's available line | no draw |
| By phone: within the plan's phone limit? | the requested amount | not accepted by phone |
| Method one of the plan's methods? | the plan's draw methods | not disbursed by that method |
| Wire for less than the wire minimum? | the requested amount | sent by ACH instead |

## Illustrations (hypothetical requests on an active loan with ample line and no maturity case)

- A wire request for USD 7840.00 on a Summit Select Line loan is below the plan's USD 10000.00 wire minimum, so it goes by ACH.
- A check request on a Summit Estate Line loan is not a method of that plan.
- A request on a Summit Condo Line loan for exactly the available line is within the line; one cent more is not.
- A draw of USD 2615.00 disbursed on a given day appears as a line draw of USD 2615.00 and an advance posting of USD 2615.00 on that same day, under one draw request confirmation number.
